notes.text: Elvis Aaron Elvis Presley was an American singer and actor.

Elvis Presley's energetic and sexually provocative performance style, combined with a mixture of influences across color lines during a transformative era in race relations, brought both great success and initial controversy.
Elvis Presley is remembered as a singer connected with United States.
Elvis Presley's recorded life dates place this profile around 1935-1977.
Elvis Presley is grouped with Literature, Arts & Culture in the People Library.
